_comment: Resource extraction -> resource KG (BrainKB Resource Ontology, BKR). Read by scripts/resource_kg.py. The ontology is brainkb_resource_ontology.owl (the BKR standalone: every module merged, no owl:imports); the policy shapes are brainkb_resource_shapes.ttl, kept outside the ontology on purpose.
_instance_base: UUIDv5 instance namespace. The same base as the NER graphs (ttl_config.json iri.base), so a paper's resource KG and its NER KG share the publication node. Changing it re-keys every instance: choose once.
_emit_skos: skos:exactMatch/broadMatch shortcuts for ACCEPTED, tool-backed mappings only; the reified ner:ConceptMappingDecision stays authoritative.
_global_resource_key: true: a resource is one node across papers, keyed on its normalised name (records, scopes, assumptions and evidence stay per paper and point at it). false: one resource node per record, as the BKR bundle does.

concept_routing._comment: Scope dimension of the extraction schema -> the extractor label whose label_routing (concept_mapping.json) restricts which ontologies may answer. A dimension mapped to null is not sent to any mapper (its label survives, unmapped): an unrestricted search maps generic words like 'analysis' to arbitrary terms.

_accepted_tiers: A tool mapping in one of these tiers is status 'accepted' (and becomes a SKOS shortcut). A weaker tool match (broad/narrow/related synonym) keeps its IRI as status 'proposed' for review.

grounding._comment: What must be stated in the source text, checked before conversion. A value that is not is removed and its field path added to not_found_fields: never invent an identifier, version, URL or licence.
grounding._verify_quotes: Every evidence quote (field_evidence, assumption/failure/benchmark/scope evidence) must occur verbatim in the source (whitespace- and quote-normalised). An unsupported quote is dropped; a validated scope left with no evidence is demoted to declared (BKR invariant 2).

_source_silence_shapes: SHACL shapes whose violations report what the SOURCE does not state (a paper rarely gives a licence or access condition). validate reports them as findings, not graph defects, and they do not fail the gate. Never fix them by inventing a licence.
_absence_shapes: Shapes whose violation is a source-silence finding only when the gap is DECLARED: the resource's record lists the field in not_found_fields (bkr:notFoundField, invariant 7: the extractor looked and the source does not say), or the node is a mention stub (named, never described). Otherwise it is an extraction gap and fails the gate.
_activity: Runs on every resource build from the command line, pipeline and batch (enabled; --no-check-activity, enabled: false or STRUCTSENSE_NO_NETWORK=1 to skip). scripts/resource_activity.py: ask GitHub/GitLab and PyPI/CRAN/Bioconductor/npm/conda whether each resource is still developed. active: last commit/release within stale_after_days; stale: within inactive_after_days; inactive: older. archived/deprecated when the host or registry says so. follow_repository: also check the source repository a registry names. Recorded as dated bkr:ActivityCheck nodes, separate from the paper-stated lifecycle status. Set GITHUB_TOKEN to lift GitHub's 60 requests/hour limit.
_metadata: The source paper's identity and bibliographic metadata. Read from the document first (JATS, the DOI and licence printed in the text, PDF metadata, the file name — a bioRxiv/medRxiv id becomes a DOI only once a registry confirms it), then, with resolve_doi, from the registry its DOI resolves at (Crossref; bioRxiv's API for preprints) for title, authors, date, venue and licence; the extractor's `paper` block fills gaps, checked against the text. STRUCTSENSE_NO_NETWORK=1 or resolve_doi: false keeps it offline. The processed text is recorded as a ner:DocumentVersion of the paper (derived from the PDF when there is one) and written next to the TTL as <out>.source.txt when it existed only in memory.
_extraction_chunk_chars: The resource extractor reads whole documents (one record per resource, deep records need Methods + Availability + Limitations together). Longer texts are split at this size and records are merged by name.
